trimComparisons.model: Subaru Forester Premium AWD (2026) vs other trims (Sport, Touring)
trimComparisons.comparison: Premium trim includes adaptive cruise control, heated front seats, moonroof, wireless phone connectivity, parking camera, auto high‑beam headlights, dual‑zone A/C—balanced between value and comfort. Sport/Touring add higher MSRP, sport styling or more advanced audio/navigation. Given pricing (~$31–32 k) vs MSRP (~$33.9 k), Premium offers cost‑effective value especially as CPO.
